test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ef78cd54eb66926daa2457eeaa5257294280b949c055be2b43b8a24c1436faa.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

All the elements shift column wise in the clockwise direction subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/205885e33111c2273ada1e87d633dc4aecec6f8a63f29913a7a374fcd2c47a4d.png] 

2) Second box series → 

The elements at the top and the bottom interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbc085a557cc5bb27c89d800445a44ee466d353238fe6f885e2b0fef46062810.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3135ad2648309efedb5674ff60b197e01f820eb4f4592a55296843cc25085237.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
